pages.text: There are three kinds of power to get.$(br2)$(l:stands/arrows)Stands$() come from $(item)Stand Arrows$(). $(l:hamon/learning)Hamon$() is a breathing technique learned from books. $(l:vampirism/stone_mask)Vampirism$() comes from the $(item)Stone Mask$(), and $(warn)sunlight kills you$().

Each one gets stronger as you use it, and so do your own stats: see $(l:basics/stats)Your Stats$().$(br2)$(warn)Vampires can't learn from Path Books$(), and a vampire who uses Hamon is torn apart by it.
